description: Determines which new ledgers need to be published by comparing the last published and last validated ledgers, and attempts to fetch or acquire any missing ledgers in the sequence.
Manages the acquisition of a ledger from the network by hash and sequence, creating or updating an InboundLedger object, and coordinating the retrieval of ledger data from peers.
Initializes the process of acquiring a ledger, setting up internal state, and beginning requests for ledger data from peers.
Processes incoming ledger data from peers, updating the acquisition state, and determining if more data is needed or if the ledger is complete.
Finalizes the acquisition process for a ledger, marks it as complete, and triggers storage or further processing depending on the acquisition reason.
Inserts a fully acquired and validated ledger into the ledger history, making it available for future queries and operations.
Checks if a newly acquired ledger has enough trusted validations to be considered validated, and if so, marks it as validated and full, and updates the current validated ledger pointer.
Adds a ledger to the internal caches by hash and sequence, ensuring it is available for fast lookup and validation.
Marks the ledger and its underlying data structures as immutable, preventing further modification and ensuring consistency.
